TRIGGER when: user writes or modifies test spec YAML (AiEvaluationDefinition); runs sf agent test create, run, run-eval, or results commands; asks about test coverage strategy, metric selection, or custom evaluations; interprets test results or diagnoses test failures; asks about batch testing, regression suites, or CI/CD test integration; requests security testing, OWASP LLM Top 10, red-teaming, penetration testing, prompt-injection tests, a security grade, or a vulnerability assessment of an agent. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user creates, modifies, previews, or debugs .agent files (use agentforce-generate); deploys or publishes agents; writes Agent Script code; uses sf agent preview for development iteration; analyzes production session traces (use agentforce-observe); performs a static safety review of .agent file content (use agentforce-generate Section 15).

中文用途: 把指定的 Agentic Atlas 模式按 ID、标题或页面依据应用到现有 skill、智能体定义、插件或工作流，输出有引用的具体修改；不处理全模式审计、开放式系统设计或无模式依据的重构。
原始用途: Turn one named Agentic Atlas pattern into concrete, cited edits to one existing artifact. Use whenever the user names a specific atlas pattern — by id, by title, or by pointing at a page on agentic-atlas.dev — and wants it applied, adopted, retrofitted, or implemented in their skill, agent definition, plugin, or workflow: "apply a pattern to my skill", "make my plugin follow this pattern", "I read this pattern on the atlas, retrofit it here". Not for a full audit against all the patterns (that is reviewing-agent-designs), not for open-ended design (designing-agent-systems), and not for refactors that don''t trace to an atlas pattern — those stay with the normal development workflow.

中文用途: 依据 Agentic Atlas 模式设计新代理系统，通过访谈厘清分解、上下文、验证和持久化边界，并为结构选择提供引用；不用于现有产物审核或普通应用设计。
原始用途: Design a new agent system with the published Agentic Atlas patterns — interview the user, consult the corpus once with the consolidated problem, and propose a decomposition where every structural choice carries its citation. Also the home for quick atlas lookups: "what does a pattern prescribe", "what does the atlas mean by X", "where do I start with the atlas". Not for auditing an artifact that already exists (that is reviewing-agent-designs), not for retrofitting one named pattern (applying-a-pattern), and not for ordinary software design — a database schema, an API, application code — that merely mentions agents.

Not for greenfield design with no artifact yet (that is designing-agent-systems), not for retrofitting one named pattern (applying-a-pattern), and not for reviewing ordinary application code — a function, an endpoint, a schema — that merely lives near agents.

中文用途: 使用 AgentMail TypeScript/Python SDK 实现收件箱、消息、线程、草稿、附件、域名、名单、pod、webhook 和 WebSocket 流程，处理 DNS 与投递故障。
原始用途: Build with the AgentMail TypeScript or Python SDK for inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment, domain, allow/block list, pod, webhook, and WebSocket workflows, including programmatic agent sign-up, domain/DNS administration, and deliverability triage (bounces, spam, blocked mail). Use when implementing or reviewing AgentMail API code; do not use for direct mailbox operations, CLI usage, MCP setup, or framework-toolkit integration.

中文用途: 通过已连接的 AgentMail MCP 阅读、搜索、总结和分类邮件，检查附件与会话，管理已读标签并识别待回复项。
原始用途: Read, search, summarize, and triage AgentMail inboxes through the connected MCP server. Use for ANY request to look at, search, or process mail — even a simple 'search my inbox for X' or 'any new mail?'; the read workflow applies regardless of task size. Also use to summarize conversations, inspect attachments, manage read/unread labels, or find messages needing a reply; do not use for sending or drafting (send-email), inbox administration (manage-inboxes), or MCP connection setup (agentmail-mcp).

中文用途: 通过 AgentMail MCP 创建、列出、查看、更新或删除收件箱，管理代理邮件地址；删除操作遵循原文规定的保护流程。
原始用途: Create, list, inspect, update, or delete AgentMail inboxes through the connected MCP server. Use for ANY inbox lifecycle request — even a quick list-inboxes or a simple delete; deletion safeguards apply regardless of task size. Also use when the user asks for a new agent email address, wants inbox details changed, or removes an inbox; do not use for sending mail (send-email), reading or triage (check-email), or MCP connection setup (agentmail-mcp).

中文用途: 通过 AgentMail MCP 起草、发送、回复或转发邮件，支持供审核的草稿及定时安排；原文要求所有发送请求遵循发送规则。
原始用途: Draft, send, reply to, or forward email through the connected AgentMail MCP server. Use for ANY request to send, reply to, or forward mail — even a quick one-line send or a simple forward that looks like a single tool call; the sending rules apply regardless of task size. Also use to compose messages, create or schedule drafts for review, or send to named recipients; do not use for reading or triaging mail (check-email), inbox administration (manage-inboxes), or MCP connection setup (agentmail-mcp).

中文用途: 顺序处理全部未关闭 PR，执行分支更新、深入审核、修复、新 CI、合并及 Jira 复盘；单轮无法修复的 PR 标为阻塞。
原始用途: Process every open PR sequentially: rebase → deep review → fix → fresh CI → merge → Jira postmortem + Done. Block PRs too broken to fix in one pass. Triggers: merge train, process all open prs, /merge-train.

中文用途: 修复 PR 审核发现的全部问题，提交、推送并重新检查，循环至满足要求；用于深入审核之后。
原始用途: Fix every PR review issue, commit, push, re-check until satisfied. Triggers: fix all, fix everything, /fix-until-satisfied. After merge-review-pr.

中文用途: 向 Jira 工单发布结构化合并后复盘并转为 Done；阻塞模式下跳过状态转换，即使 PR 无问题也记录复盘。
原始用途: Post structured post-merge comment to Jira ticket + transition to Done (skip transition in blocked mode). Mandatory even on 0-issue PRs. Triggers: jira postmortem, comment jira, /jira-postmortem.

中文用途: 逐个完整阅读 PR 变更文件，深入检查正确性、安全、命名、测试、文档和验收标准，按严重程度报告。
原始用途: Deep PR review: read every changed file in full, check correctness/security/naming/tests/docs/ACs. Report by severity. Triggers: review pr, /review-pr. Use instead of /review for file-level depth.

中文用途: 将 main 更新合入 PR 分支并解决冲突，运行合入后的 lint 门禁；原文具体使用 merge --no-ff，仅产生合并提交时推送。
原始用途: Rebase PR branch on main: merge --no-ff, resolve conflicts intelligently, lint-after-rebase gate, push only if merge commit created. Triggers: update pr, merge main into, /update-pr.

中文用途: 在项目周期开始时于 Confluence 创建愿景文档，作为后续需求工作的输入。
原始用途: Vision Doc in Confluence. Triggers: new idea, start project, create vision doc. Cycle start, before skill 2.

中文用途: 根据已有愿景文档在 Confluence 起草 PRD，衔接需求与后续设计工作。
原始用途: PRD in Confluence from Vision Doc. Triggers: write PRD, draft requirements. After skill 1, before skill 3.

中文用途: 在 Confluence 创建设计简报，采用 BRIEF 或 INTEGRATE 模式形成 UI 规格或整合已有设计稿。
原始用途: Design Brief in Confluence (BRIEF or INTEGRATE mode). Triggers: design brief, UI specs, integrate mockups. After skill 2, before skill 4.

中文用途: 在 Confluence 编写 ADR 并评估技术可行性，记录架构决策。
原始用途: ADR + tech feasibility in Confluence. Triggers: write ADR, architecture decisions, assess tech. After skill 3, before skill 5.

中文用途: 在冲刺结束前检查跨仓库混入内容、无效 CI、预构建镜像机会、过时指令、错误位置产物和死代码；先报告再应用清理。
原始用途: End-of-sprint housekeeping before closeout: audit cross-repo leakage, useless CI, prebuild-image wins, CLAUDE.md/SKILL.md cruft, misplaced artifacts, dead code. Report before apply. Triggers: tech debt sweep, cleanup sweep, housekeeping, /tech-debt-sweep. Before agile-13-sprint-closeout.

中文用途: 在最终合并和技术债清理后执行冲刺收尾门禁，从工程师的冒烟集成、架构师的规格实现对比及技术负责人全部差异深审三个视角核验。
原始用途: Mandatory end-of-sprint epic gate, 3 lenses: engineer (smoke + integration), architect (Confluence specs vs delivered code), tech lead (deep severity-graded review of all sprint diffs). Triggers: sprint closeout, close sprint, /sprint-closeout. After last merge + agile-12-tech-debt-sweep, before retro.

中文用途: 对已合并且状态为 Done 的故事做 QA 验收：确认 main 上仍满足验收条件并签署通过，不改变状态；发现回归时新建 Bug，不重新打开故事。在 agile-13-sprint-closeout 后、技能 15 前使用，适用于验证故事、QA 检查及确认验收条件。
原始用途: QA validation, confirm-after-merge: Story already Done (merged) — confirm ACs hold on main, stamp sign-off, no transition. Regression → file a Bug, never reopen. Triggers: validate story, QA story, QA check, confirm ACs. After agile-13-sprint-closeout, before skill 15.

中文用途: 所有故事完成后，在 Confluence 进行冲刺复盘并更新路线图，适用于运行复盘、关闭冲刺及总结经验；完成后交给技能 5。
原始用途: Sprint retro in Confluence + Roadmap update. Triggers: run retro, close sprint, what did we learn. After all Stories Done, hands off to skill 5.

中文用途: 交替运行 agile-10-implement 实现与 agile-11-merge-train 合并，直到当前冲刺两端都清空（DRAINED）或受阻（STUCK）。支持 concurrency=N 与 dispatch=session，适用于持续实现合并、清空看板和完成冲刺。
原始用途: Drain the active sprint to a fixed point: auto-alternate agile-10-implement (build) and agile-11-merge-train (merge) until both empty (DRAINED) or blocked (STUCK). Optional concurrency=N, dispatch=session. Triggers: drain the sprint, run the sprint to completion, implement and merge until done, clear the whole board, ship the sprint.

中文用途: 集成 Agora 到应用，构建语音 AI 智能体、音视频通话、直播、屏幕共享、应用内消息和在线状态、录制及令牌认证流程；也用于 agora CLI 登录、快速入门、环境配置、诊断、能力查询、技能和 MCP 服务。
原始用途: Activate when the user wants to build voice AI agents, video or voice calls, live streaming, screen sharing, in-app messaging and presence, recording, token or auth flows, or use the `agora` CLI for login, quickstarts, env setup, diagnostics, introspection, skills, or MCP serving, especially when integrating Agora into an app.

中文用途: 分析用户的 Claude Code 与 Cowork 历史会话，整理任务类型、频率、成功程度和阻力，提出减少反复迭代的独立技能建议。适用于分析 Claude 使用、任务画像和令牌花费模式；输出可分享的 profile.csv、含 AI 优先原则对比及令牌图表的个人辅导 explorer.html，以及 skill-proposals.md。
原始用途: Mine the user's Claude Code + Cowork session history into a structured task profile, what they do with AI, how often, how successfully where friction lives, then propose atomic skills that would reduce iteration. Use when the user asks to "analyse my Claude use", "build a task profile", "what tasks do I do with Claude", "where am I spending tokens", "what skills would help me", or mentions reviewing past sessions for patterns. Produces profile.csv (shareable), explorer.html (personal coaching view with AI-first principle comparison + token-spend chart), and skill-proposals.md.

中文用途: 读取本地 Claude Code 与 Cowork 会话，诊断对话长度分布、超长会话占比、缓存重建费用及各项目的使用效率，在终端展示结果；可进一步用并行 Haiku 子智能体分析高成本和高效率会话并生成简洁 Markdown 报告。适用于个人令牌成本和使用习惯诊断。
原始用途: Personal diagnosis of where your Claude Code + Cowork spend goes. Reads local transcripts, prints your conversation length distribution, marathon share, cache rebuild costs, and per-project diagnosis (good projects and problem projects) right in the terminal. Then offers a deeper dive that fans out parallel Haiku subagents over your most expensive (and most efficient) sessions and writes a tight Markdown report. Use when the user asks "why is my Claude spend so high", "where am I burning tokens", "diagnose my Claude habits", "audit my Claude usage", or asks for a personal token-cost diagnosis.

中文用途: 在已连接 DataLabs 的 AI Context Bridge for HubSpot MCP（mcp.datalabs.store）时，分析 HubSpot 交易、销售管道、联系人、公司、互动、邮件活动及工作流；也用于表和模式探索、SQL 生成调试，以及复用或调整加权管道、预测校准、停滞交易、互动与赢单率、收入集中度和邮件归因分析。
原始用途: Use when the user has connected their DataLabs "AI Context Bridge for HubSpot" MCP connector (tools like execute_query, get_tables_list, get_full_database_schema, get_semantic_metadata, save_query, list_saved_queries pointed at mcp.datalabs.store) and asks analytical questions about their HubSpot data — deals, pipeline, contacts, companies, engagements, email campaigns, or workflows. Also use for schema exploration ("what tables do I have"), SQL generation/debugging against this connector, or reproducing/adapting known revenue-ops analyses (weighted pipeline, forecast calibration, stuck deals, engagement-vs-win-rate, revenue concentration, email attribution).

中文用途: 首日手动初始化广告管理，之后每月运行：先研究企业公开资料，读取账户结构，建立计划、看板、创意准则、仪表板和定时任务。只询问决定支出上限的月度预算与每日限额；月度运行重新读取证据、按台账纠错并校正偏差。
原始用途: Runs once by hand on the first day and once a month after that. On the first run it researches the business from its own public surfaces before asking anything, reads the account structure once, writes the plan folder, seeds the board, creates the creative doctrine, builds the dashboard, and registers the recurring jobs. It asks about exactly two things, the monthly ceiling and the daily cap, because those are the two numbers that decide how much money can leave. On every monthly run it re reads the evidence, corrects what the ledgers prove wrong, and reconciles drift.

中文用途: 工作日只读广告账户：先确认读取窗口内主要转化事件仍有发生，再按账户、广告活动、广告组和创意读取昨日花费、投放及结果。每个对象每天追加一行指标并附界面、日期范围和读取日；未经渠道放行不创建、保存、激活或花费。
原始用途: Weekdays. The only routine in this kit that opens a screen inside an account that can spend, and everything it does there is read. It confirms the primary conversion event still fired inside the read window before it trusts any other figure, then reads yesterday's spend, delivery, and result rows at account, campaign, ad set, and creative level and appends one row per object per day to the daily metrics ledger with the screen, the date range, and the read date beside every figure. It creates nothing, saves nothing, activates nothing, and spends nothing, unless you released the channel.

中文用途: 工作日每次处理一张就绪卡片，制作可直接粘贴的本地广告活动配置表、否定关键词文件、转化动作规格、受众定义或上传包。在 RELEASES.md 放行账户前全程只用文本编辑器；放行后由步骤 6a 通过已有连接发布批准包，并为平台返回的每个 ID 留存回执。
原始用途: Weekdays. Works the next ready card on the board, one card per run, and assembles what it needs as a complete local file ready to paste: a campaign build sheet, a negative keyword file, a conversion action specification, an audience definition, or an upload packet. The whole step happens in a text editor until you release the ad account in RELEASES.md, and then Step 6a publishes the approved package through a connection you already have and writes a receipt for every id the platform returns.

中文用途: 每周五全程只读，依据每日指标台账给本周评分，制作下周账户调整的优先列表；每项列出改动、准确界面、现值、建议值及证据行。不提出无来源的变更，不执行调整；支出仅限已放行范围。
原始用途: Weekly, on a Friday, read only everywhere. Scores the week from the daily metrics ledger alone, with the screen and the date range beside every number, then writes the ranked paste ready list of what to change in the account next week. Each line names one change, the exact screen, the current value, the proposed value, and the evidence row it came from. It proposes no change it cannot source, it names no action it took because it takes none, and it spends only where you released it.

中文用途: 每月最后一个工作日，将创意台账与每日指标核对，按角度、形式、开场钩子及优惠表达评估成效，而非逐文件评分。用当月实测结果复核并修订创意准则，记录疲劳曲线、淘汰未见收益的方案；样本不足以区分角度时不调整。
原始用途: Monthly, on the last weekday. Folds a month of the creative ledger against the daily metrics ledger to score angle, format, hook, and offer framing rather than individual files, tests every line currently in the creative doctrine against what the month actually measured, and rewrites the doctrine where the evidence disagrees with the assumption. It records the fatigue curve it observed, retires what has not earned, and changes nothing where the month holds too few rows to tell one angle from another.

中文用途: 工作日按现有创意准则和指标衰减证据，每次制作一套创意，将图片和准确文案写入注明目标界面的日期文件夹并登记卡片。不打开账户或上传；发送与花费仅限已放行渠道，不接触凭据。
原始用途: Weekdays. Produces one creative set per run against evidence rather than taste, reading the standing doctrine for the angles currently earning and the metrics ledger for what has decayed. It writes the images and the exact strings into a dated local set folder with the destination screen named, files one card, and uploads nothing to any account. It never opens an account screen, sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.

中文用途: 工作日只处理文件、不使用浏览器：读取运行记录并汇总指标、变更和创意台账，将昨日勾选变为可统计事实，合并卡片收件箱、重写看板并生成晨报。外发须先放行渠道，不接触凭据。
原始用途: Weekdays, file work only, no browser at all. Reads every run record, folds the metrics, change, and creative ledgers, turns yesterday's ticks into facts a machine can count, folds the card inbox, rewrites the board, and writes the short morning brief the member opens first. It holds every outbound action unless you released the channel, and it never touches a credential.

中文用途: 首日手动建立参谋长职责与 AI 员工清单，之后每月复核：研究企业公开资料，为章程结论标注来源日期，在限定范围内发现本机已安装员工，生成共享映射、优先事项、观察列表和仪表板，并注册自身七项任务。月度重新发现和校正清单；不写其他员工目录、不注册他人任务，发送和支出限已放行渠道，不接触凭据。
原始用途: Runs once by hand on the first day and once a month after that. On the first run it researches the business from its own public presence, writes the charter with a source and a date beside every conclusion, discovers the AI Employees actually installed on this machine within a bounded search, writes the map every other routine in this kit reads, seeds the priorities and the watchlist once, builds the fleet dashboard, and registers this Employee's own seven jobs. On every monthly run it re-runs discovery and reconciles the map against what is really there. It never writes into another Employee's folder, never registers a job it does not own, sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.

中文用途: 每周只读本地文件，选出恰好三项行动建议，逐一论证正反两面，每个论据附文件中的数字或观察。最后反驳自身首选建议，记录预测效果及可检验指标并登记各项行动，供月度复核；发送和支出限放行范围，不部署、不接触凭据。
原始用途: Weekly, file work only, no browser at all. Reads everything the week produced, picks exactly three moves, and argues both sides of each one before the member reads a word of it, with every clause carrying a number or an observation from a file it names. It argues against its own top recommendation last, records a predicted effect and the metric that would show it so the monthly review can score it, and files each move onto the register. It sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, never deploys, and never touches a credential.

中文用途: 每月最后一个工作日只处理文件，以实际指标文件评估自身决策，汇总决策台账并给已关闭决策追加结果；淘汰提出三次仍未获采纳的行动，按证据重写优先事项。关闭决策太少时不公布校准指标，不写自身目录外、不向他人提案；发送和支出限放行范围，不接触凭据。
原始用途: Monthly, on the last weekday, file work only, no browser at all. Folds the decision ledger, scores this Employee's own judgement against the metric files that measured it rather than against its own predictions, appends one outcome line per closed decision, retires a move proposed three times and never accepted, and rewrites the priorities where the evidence disagrees with them. It refuses to publish a calibration figure on too few closed decisions, changes nothing outside its own folder, proposes nothing to anybody, sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.

中文用途: 工作日只处理文件，将员工群中排名最高的未解决故障整理成可快速行动的档案：一句话故障、首个记录、同期变化、三项带证据的排序原因、损失及带准确路径的可粘贴修正。其他员工资料严格只读，只写自身目录；发送和支出限放行范围，不接触凭据。
原始用途: Weekdays, file work only, no browser at all. Takes the single highest ranked open fault on the fleet and turns it into something the member can act on in a minute: the fault in one sentence, the first record that shows it, what changed around that date, three ranked causes each with its evidence line, what the failure has cost, and one paste ready correction line with the exact path it belongs in. It reads other Employees strictly read only, writes nothing outside its own folder, sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.

中文用途: 工作日只读本机各 AI 员工运行日志，将例程分为运行中、明确停机、静默停机或暂停，更新故障持续时间、汇总决策登记并写晨报。不写其他员工目录；发送和支出限放行范围，不接触凭据。
原始用途: Weekdays, file work only, no browser at all. Walks every AI Employee installed on this machine, reads each one's own run log strictly read only, classifies every routine as running, stopped loudly, stopped silently, or paused, ages the faults, folds the decision register, and writes the one short brief the member opens first. It never writes into another Employee's folder, sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.

中文用途: 每周集中浏览自身观察列表，对真实变化记录日期、原文引述和准确 URL，并写有篇幅上限的周报。没有基线的资料不报告变化；对外全程只读，不输入会改变状态的内容，绝不在 LinkedIn 操作；发送和支出限放行范围，不接触凭据。
原始用途: Weekly, heavy browser lane, read only toward the world with no exception. Works the surfaces on its own watchlist through one contiguous browser phase, captures one dated observation per real change with a verbatim quote and the exact URL, refuses to report any change against a surface it has no baseline for, and writes one capped weekly page. It types nothing that changes anything, takes no action on LinkedIn ever, sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.

中文用途: 每周只读评估员工群与业务，每个数字必须有来源，引用指标所属员工的结果而不重新计算；低于规定样本门槛时不报告比率，输出限篇幅周报。仅在指标映射指定实时界面时打开浏览器，不写其他员工目录；发送和支出限放行范围，不接触凭据。
原始用途: Weekly, conditional browser lane, read only everywhere. Scores the fleet and the business for the week with a source beside every single number and no number anywhere without one, cites the Employee that owns a metric rather than recomputing it, refuses a rate below the floor, and writes one capped weekly page. It opens a browser only where the metric map names a live screen, never writes into another Employee's folder, sends only where you released the channel, spends only where you released it, and never touches a credential.

中文用途: 工作日读取工单台账以及用户指定的账户、账单和使用资料，识别可能流失的付费客户。每个标记包含触发规则、准确证据、完整客户历史及带成本和操作界面的挽留建议；账单界面只读，仅说明退款、抵扣、套餐变更和取消，不执行。
原始用途: Weekdays, conditional browser lane. Reads the ticket ledger and the account, billing, and usage surfaces the member named, and decides which paying customers are about to leave. Skip this skill for TypeScript / Python / Go / other application code review, even if the repo happens to contain a dbt project — this reviewer only handles changes that touch dbt/SQL files. Read-only — never modifies files.

中文用途: 逐步指导将库存送入 Amazon FBA：建立入库计划、打包、分仓、运输、送达窗口及确认发货，也处理状态、修改、取消、跟踪、FNSKU 标签和预处理要求。按 CREATE→PACK→PLACE→TRANSPORT→DELIVER→SHIP 顺序等待异步完成，每个决策门由卖家选择；不用于缺货预测、商品问题、广告或订单。

中文用途: 与 experiment-result-reader 配合，以各变体曝光与转化计算胜过对照的后验概率、可信区间和预期损失；比例用 Beta-Binomial，连续指标用 Normal-Normal。结合信心阈值与损失容忍度给决策，用于即将上线的 A/B 结果、胜出概率或边界 p 值的贝叶斯视角；适用 Clamp 或其他来源的逐变体计数。

Beta-Binomial for proportion metrics (CVR), Normal-Normal for continuous metrics (revenue per user). Decision rule combines a confidence threshold with an expected-loss tolerance, so the ship decision reflects both "how likely is this better?" and "how bad is it if I'm wrong?". Use this skill alongside experiment-result-reader when reading any A/B test result. Pairs with analytics-diagnostic-method. Use whenever interpreting an A/B test result the user plans to ship from, when the question is "what's the chance variant wins?", or when a frequentist p-value is on the edge and the user wants the posterior view. Triggers when Clamp MCP returns experiment exposure and conversion data, or when any analytics source surfaces per-variant counts.

中文用途: 在用观察数据判断因果前建立可修订 Mermaid 因果 DAG，用后门准则确定调整变量，明确混杂、媒介和碰撞变量，供下游选调整集。用于无实验对照的群体差异、漏斗流失或因果解释，配合分析诊断法；涵盖 Clamp 群体比较及漏斗。
原始用途: Build a refinable causal DAG before answering "did X cause Y" on observational data. Emits a Mermaid diagram of assumed causes, applies the back-door criterion to decide what to condition on, and forces confounders, mediators, and colliders to be named explicitly instead of "controlling for everything". The DAG is an artifact downstream skills read to pick the right adjustment set. Use whenever interpreting cohort comparisons, funnel drop-offs, or any analytics result where the user is reasoning causally without an experiment. Pairs with analytics-diagnostic-method as the causal-structure layer underneath the diagnostic tree. Triggers when Clamp MCP cohorts_compare or funnels_create is called with no experimental holdback, when a Clamp MCP result prompts a causal claim from observational data, or when via Clamp the user asks "why did this segment convert higher".

中文用途: 在依据观察分析建议回滚、上线、放弃或扩大前，用 Bradford Hill 九视角检查 X 是否导致 Y，区分偶然、混杂及反向因果；约少于五项通过时不标高信心。配合诊断树及渠道漏斗细分，适用于发布与指标变化关联，方法不依赖供应商，Clamp 可映射到流量比较拆分、错误时间线和漏斗。
原始用途: Bradford Hill's 9 viewpoints (1965) reframed as a checklist for product analytics. Use this skill before recommending a decision based on observational analytics data. Applies the 9 Bradford Hill viewpoints to score whether X actually caused Y, or whether the correlation is coincidental, confounded, or reversed. Use whenever interpreting a metric change the user is about to act on (rollback, ship, abandon, double-down). Refuses to label a verdict "high confidence" when fewer than ~5 of the 9 criteria pass. Pairs with analytics-diagnostic-method (which provides the hypothesis tree) and channel-and-funnel-quality (which provides the segmentation discipline). Triggers when Clamp MCP returns a comparison the user is about to act on, when a deploy correlates with a metric move, or when the user says "X caused Y" / "did X cause Y" / "should we roll back / ship / kill X" based on a chart. Vendor-neutral methodology; via Clamp MCP the per-criterion checks map directly to traffic.compare, traffic.breakdown, errors.timeline, and funnels.list.

中文用途: 回答为什么或假设问题前，按 Pearl 三层因果层级标为关联、干预或反事实。无后门、工具变量、双重差分、断点或合成控制等识别策略时，不把观察关联升级成上线或停止建议。配合诊断法，适用于用户将依据趋势或比较采取行动；可用任意观察来源，Clamp 为典型集成。
原始用途: Pearl's three-rung causal hierarchy as a query classifier. Tags every analytics question as rung-1 (association, P(Y|X)), rung-2 (intervention, P(Y|do(X))), or rung-3 (counterfactual, P(Y_x|Y',X')) before answering. Refuses to escalate a rung-1 observational finding into a rung-2 ship/kill recommendation without naming an identification strategy (back-door, instrumental variable, DiD, RDD, synthetic control). Use this skill whenever interpreting an analytics question that asks why or what-if, to classify it on Pearl's causal hierarchy before answering. Pairs with analytics-diagnostic-method. Triggers when Clamp MCP returns a comparison or trend that the user is about to act on, so the agent labels the claim's rung explicitly instead of laundering correlation into causation. Works with any observational source; Clamp MCP is the canonical integration via traffic.compare, funnels.list, and cohorts.compare.

中文用途: 构建排查优化 CloudWatch 与 CloudWatch Omni 可观测性：日志查询、指标告警、仪表板、X-Ray/ADOT、CloudTrail、合成监控、动态仪表化、Application Signals，以及 Omni SQL/PromQL、视图警报、上下文图和 OTel 智能体质量评价。适用于 Signals 接入及已接入 Omni 日常操作；首次 Omni 空间域、授权、摄取和新空间仪表化用 setting-up-cloudwatch-observability。

中文用途: 在每次代码变更、新端点或后端修改完成前进行安全检查，识别对象级越权、批量赋值、注入、密钥泄漏及缺少认证等常见漏洞。
原始用途: Use on every diff, every new endpoint, every change to a backend component. Treats security as a per-change reflex, not an audit phase. 中文用途: 从外部编码智能体通过 MCP 或 base44 sandbox CLI 连接 Base44 沙箱进行远程开发，涵盖认证、读写/编辑/运行工具、检查点、预览、应用状态和连接器，说明修改、预览、验证循环及与构建器并发协作。
原始用途: Develop a Base44 app remotely from your own coding agent (Claude Code, claude.ai, or any MCP client) by connecting it to the Base44 sandbox. Cloud agents connect over MCP; local agents can connect over MCP or drive the same sandbox with the `base44 sandbox` CLI subcommands (the CLI uses shorter names — e.g. read_file is `sandbox read`, list_directory is `sandbox ls`, run_command is `sandbox run`). Covers connecting/ authenticating, the available sandbox tools (run_command, read_file, write_file, edit_file, grep, list_directory, create_checkpoint, get_app_preview_url, get_app_status, list_user_apps, and the connector tools list_connectors / initiate_connector_connection), the edit→preview→verify loop, how changes persist, builder/external-agent concurrency, the in-editor "Send to Coding Agent" button + onboarding README URLs, and tips like reading the Vite dev-server logs. Triggers on "develop my Base44 app remotely", "connect Claude Code to Base44", "bring my own agent", "edit a Base44 app over MCP", "Base44 sandbox MCP", or "Send to Coding Agent".

中文用途: 在 Base44 云沙箱直接开发应用，无需本地检出或部署推送命令；写入资源文件即自动同步后端函数、实体和智能体，通过 MCP 或无项目 connectors CLI 配置远程 OAuth 连接器。
原始用途: Develop a Base44 app remotely inside Base44's cloud sandbox using your own agent — no local checkout and no deploy/push commands. The implementation is remote: writing a resource file into the sandbox is what ships it (backend functions, entities, and agents all auto-sync from the file you write), and OAuth connectors are set up against the remote app via MCP tools or the projectless `base44 connectors` CLI. This skill is the place for learning what you can author in the sandbox, how backend functions, entities, and agents are structured, and how to connect a connector without a local filesystem. Triggers on 'develop my Base44 app remotely', 'no local files', 'cloud sandbox', 'create an entity/agent remotely', 'connect a connector remotely', 'bring my own agent', or any work editing a Base44 app inside a sandbox.

Covers why a shaderset seems invalid, why .info top values are not alpha coordinates, and why Mega-Bezel per-game art fails. Not for performance/framerate tuning (batocera-tuning).

原始用途: Use when keeping a Batocera cabinet healthy over time: running scripts or scheduled jobs at boot and on an interval without cron, the custom_service boot-service pattern (which replaced custom.sh in v43), backing up /userdata to another machine over SSH, and upgrading between major Batocera versions (v42 to v43 and similar) including the ROM-directory renames and post-upgrade checklist. Covers why there is no crond, the backup-before-upgrade doctrine, and catch-up scheduling. Not for performance tuning (batocera-tuning).

原始用途: Use when connecting to or operating a Batocera arcade/retro-gaming cabinet over SSH: establishing the connection, understanding its read-only rootfs and /userdata layout, finding config/log/ROM paths, applying changes safely, verifying a display/config change end-to-end without a controller, or diagnosing why a setting reverts to its default on every launch (configgen). Foundation for the other batocera-* skills (roms, display, tuning, maintenance). Covers sshpass, batocera.conf, EmulationStation, the ES HTTP API, and batocera-screenshot. Not for game recommendations.

中文用途: 管理 Batocera ROM 与游戏列表，确认目录和格式、排查菜单缺失、以隐藏方式整理库、安全编辑 gamelist.xml、整理多碟游戏并用 No-Intro/Redump DAT 校验；不用于着色器或版本升级造成的目录改名。
原始用途: Use when working with ROMs and gamelists on a Batocera cabinet: figuring out which directory a system''s ROMs go in, why a game does not appear in the menu, which file formats and extensions a system accepts, curating a large library by hiding rather than deleting, editing gamelist.xml safely, cleaning up multi-disc games, or verifying dumps against No-Intro/Redump DATs. Covers extensionless-ROM-in-zip failures, the 3DO/Opera no-m3u trap, cave3rd, and the es_systems_custom.cfg landmine. Not for shaders/bezels (batocera-display), or ROM directories renamed by a Batocera version upgrade (batocera-maintenance).

中文用途: 诊断 Batocera 菜单迟缓、启动后变慢、CPU 节能模式、超频无效、输入延迟、持续掉帧或重型 3D 游戏崩溃卡顿；先检查降频，再结合硬件选择渲染分辨率和后端，不用于着色器画质调整。
原始用途: Use when a Batocera cabinet feels slow, laggy, or stuttery, or when tuning performance: EmulationStation menu/carousel lag, a slow-since-boot frontend, CPU governor stuck in powersave, overclock or CPU-speed core options that seem to do nothing, run-ahead / input latency, framerate that drops the longer the machine runs, or a 3D-heavy game (PSX/PS2/Dreamcast/N64 class) that crashes or stutters — Vulkan errors in emulator logs, picking a rendering resolution or graphics backend the hardware can afford. Covers the diagnostic order (check the throttle first), the v43 governor-at-boot failure, the emulator-name vs rom-dir-name overclock scoping trap, ES event-hook frame cost, and hardware-tier detection (batocera-info / batocera-vulkan). Not for shader visual quality (batocera-display).

Output is a self-contained interactive HTML file with folder rollups, direct-vs-via-group grant paths, DSPM case links, and unused-access findings. Scope note: use this for org-wide or multi-resource access mapping; for a text-only deep dive on one named file/user/group, prefer the aci-effective-permissions skill if installed.

Triggers: "build me a list of", "find 50 <title> at <segment>", "who works at", "find work emails for these accounts", "enrich this CSV", "verify these emails", "build a TAM", "who fits our ICP", "who actually buys from us", "what data points should we collect on accounts", "our outbound is reaching the wrong people", "score these leads", "write a first-touch email", "push these to my CRM", "who changed jobs", "who just raised funding", "companies using <tech>", "who is hiring <role>", "find the buying committee", "portfolio companies of <investor>", "upload this audience to Google/Meta/LinkedIn ads". Providers: aiArk, anthropic, apolloio, bouncer, brightData, builtwith, cleon1, companyEnrich, contactOut, datagma, dropcontact, enrichCrm, enrichley, enrowio, exa, findyMail, firecrawl, forager, FullEnrich, g2, gemini, hunter, icypeas, kitt, leadMagic, linkedin, linkup, mixrank, neverBounce, oceanio, openAi, parallel, peopleDataLabs, perplexity, piloterr, prospeo, proxycurl, reverseContact, rocketreach, salesNavigator, serper, sillage, snitcher, societeInfo, theirStack, theSwarm, waterfall, x, zeroBounce. Reads phase guides, recipes, and per-provider playbooks before any paid call. Skip when: a run already happened and misbehaved — use cargo-diagnostics.

中文用途: 从Cargo部署托管网页应用或HTTP无服务器边缘Worker，管理构建升级、环境变量密钥、本地运行、自定义域名及搜索索引；需作为已提交工作空间代码声明时用cargo-project。

Triggers: "build me a dashboard for this", "host this app", "give me a URL to share", "deploy this", "I need a webhook endpoint", "make it live", "promote to production", "ship a UI for my team", "give my worker an API token", "set a secret on the worker", "Missing CARGO_API_TOKEN", "my app cannot call my worker", "run the worker locally", "put it on my own domain", "make the site indexable by Google". 中文用途: 管理Cargo拥有的发送邮箱，配置域名邮箱、预热及每日5至40封递增发送、发送并读取会话回复投递事件和屏蔽名单；每次发送受依据、屏蔽与相关性约束，邮箱按月扣积分，文案受众或Git声明另用对应技能。
原始用途: Send mail from inboxes Cargo owns — provision mailboxes on a sending domain, run provider warm-up and the 5→40/day send ramp, deliver with the `sendEmail` action, and read back threads, replies, delivery events, and the workspace suppression list. Triggers: "set up a sending mailbox", "provision inboxes for outbound", "warm up this mailbox", "how many sends do I have left today", "send this from Cargo", "did they reply", "who unsubscribed", "suppress this recipient", "take me off your list", "never email them again", "what do mailboxes cost", "my mailbox is stuck pending". A mailbox is a recurring monthly credit charge, and every send is gated on basis, suppression, and relevance. Skip when: writing the copy or building the audience — use cargo-gtm; the mailbox belongs in git — use cargo-project.

Triggers: "connect Cargo to Claude Desktop", "add Cargo to ChatGPT", "Cargo MCP server", "mcp.getcargo.io", "use Cargo without installing anything", "which Cargo tool do I call", "search_actions", "execute_action_batch", "MCP server is showing the wrong workspace". 中文用途: 监测Cargo工作空间并配置定时阈值告警，检查流程遥测、存储新鲜度行数或SQL查询，触发连接器工具或智能体；支持告警列举预览编辑和历史评审，已有故障原因用诊断技能。

Triggers: "run this on all my contacts", "execute the action", "kick off a batch", "build a workflow", "schedule a play", "make it run every morning", "ask the agent", "show me the workflow", "what does this tool do", "visualize this play", "draw the graph", "explain this workflow", "how many runs failed today", "what is the output schema for this action", "add a step that". Triggers: "as code", "in git", "version-controlled", "reproducible", "Terraform for Cargo", "set up a whole workspace", "staging and production", "deploy the workspace from CI", "review this in a PR", "cargo.state.json", "scaffold from a template", "is there a cookbook for this", "start from a cookbook". Skills with a CDK example (TAM building, account scoring, contact sourcing, routing, AI SDR, rep cockpit) live in gtm-skills; menu in references/cookbooks.md. Explains what each skill owns, declarative workspace-as-code (cargo-project) vs the imperative CLI, the UUID and slug flow between skills, async polling of runs and batches, end-to-end use cases, and the gotchas that fail silently (`conjonction` spelling, run vs batch, model-uuid vs segment-uuid). 中文用途: 为指定Carta股权表公司建设或重建名为Carta Home - 公司名的已发布实时仪表板；基金SOI/业绩/LP首页和CRM首页分别用对应技能。

Use when the user asks to "build cap table home", "rebuild cap table home", "deploy cap table home", or asks to build, rebuild, deploy or set up Carta Home for a named company or corporation. For a fund firm's Carta Home (SOI, fund performance, LP reporting), use carta-investors' carta-home-build instead; for a CRM home of pipeline, deals and contacts, use carta-crm's carta-crm-home-build.

原始用途: Serves a live, clickable CTC console — builds one corporation's Carta Total Compensation data into a React app on localhost, where you filter by job area, compare peer groups and explore the scorecard yourself. CLAUDE CODE ONLY; it serves a local web app. Use it when the ask is to run an app, launch a console, or explore the data live, rather than to be told a figure. Invoke with a corporation name or id, e.g. "launch a comp dashboard for Acme". Its Benchmarks and Scorecard tabs are surfaces inside the app, not separately routable. Route by deliverable, not subject — an answer, CSV or figure to quote belongs to a sibling even when the wording overlaps: use carta-compensation-benchmarks for a role's market rate, and carta-compensation-scorecard for roster positioning, compa-ratios or who is below market. So "what are our comp benchmarks" is a sibling even though it names them, while "open our comp benchmarks so I can filter them" is this skill. NOT for a single role lookup. READ-ONLY.

中文用途: 查询指定职位的Carta Total Compensation薪资、股权和总现金市场基准，输出聊天或CSV及P25/P50/P75；不用于职位分类、公司员工相对市场定位、基金业绩或股权结构基准。
原始用途: Retrieves Carta Total Compensation market benchmarks (salary, equity, total cash) for a role. Output to chat or CSV. Market benchmarks are triggered by queries like: "sales benchmarks", "comp benchmarks", "market rate", "what does a [role] pay", "put benchmarks in a CSV", "get benchmarks", "get carta's market benchmarks", "show me benchmarks for [role]", "compensation ranges for [role]", "p25/p50/p75 for [role]". Do NOT use for job classification or role mapping — use carta-compensation-rolematcher for that. Do NOT use for "how is OUR company positioned vs market", "who at our company is below market", or "our internal pay bands vs benchmarks" — those are roster-level positioning, use carta-compensation-scorecard. Do NOT use for fund performance benchmarks (use carta-performance-benchmarks) or portfolio structural metrics like SAFE terms and option pool sizes (use carta-market-benchmarks).

中文用途: 将职位名称或描述映射至CTC分类的职能、专长、级别与轨道；不查询薪酬基准、不评估公司员工市场定位，也不用于无关职业建议。

Use when the user wants to know how a role is categorized or mapped to the taxonomy structure — not to fetch salary, equity, or benchmark numbers. Do NOT use when the user is asking for "market rates", "benchmark data", "compensation ranges", "what does X pay", or "show me benchmarks" — use carta-compensation-benchmarks for that. Do NOT use when the user is asking how their own company compares to market — e.g. "our internal pay bands vs Carta benchmarks", "compare our pay bands against the 25th/50th/75th percentile", "who at our company is below market" — that's roster-level positioning, use carta-compensation-scorecard. Do NOT use for general career advice or job search queries unrelated to compensation benchmarking.

中文用途: 基于已接入并由HRIS同步的公司员工名单，提供CTC公司汇总和逐人评分卡，显示低于符合高于市场的分布、compa-ratio、分位与市场档位；不用于单职位市场值、分类或基金评分。
原始用途: Carta Total Compensation scorecard — shows how a corporation's employees compare to market. Two lenses: corporation-level rollup (band distribution — what % of employees are below / at / above market) and per-employee scorecard (each employee's compa-ratio + percentile + market band). Triggered by queries like: "scorecard", "how is our comp positioned", "who's below market", "which employees are below P50", "show me the roster", "are we paying market", "comp posture", "employee compa-ratios", "is [employee] underpaid", "pay adjustment analysis", "our internal pay bands vs benchmarks", "score these employees". Operates on the corporation's already-ingested CTC roster (HRIS-synced employees). Do NOT use for market-rate lookups for a role (use carta-compensation-benchmarks). Do NOT use for job classification (use carta-compensation-rolematcher). Do NOT use for fund performance scorecards or portfolio-level metrics.

中文用途: 计算融资交割时SAFE与可转债转股，解释定价轮转换股数及计算；退出出售收购收益分配另用瀑布情景技能。

Use when asked about SAFE conversion, note conversion, conversion shares, conversion math, how instruments convert in a priced round, or what happens to outstanding SAFEs and notes when a new round closes. Do NOT use for exit/sale/acquisition payouts at a sale price — those are waterfall scenarios, prefer a waterfall-scenarios skill.

The matching specialist skill wins every time over this one.

NOT for portfolio-level / all-employees aggregate vesting.

原始用途: Use this skill when the user says /performance, /digest, asks for a weekly Claude performance report, or wants to review how their Claude Code sessions have been going. Reads JSONL session files from ~/.claude/projects/, computes six effectiveness metrics (activity distribution, one-shot edit rate, subagent turn count, model mix, project allocation, hookify firings), fires diagnostic rules when thresholds breach, and writes behavioral rules into ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md so future sessions adapt. Closes the measurement loop for self-improving AI workflows.

Auto-detects project context for typical projects; reads optional per-project config from `.claude/release.config.json` and lifecycle markdown overrides in `.claude/release/`.

中文用途: 通过 pge-orchestrator 的 pge_update 将 PGE Orchestrator 更新到最新版本，显示结果；工具提示需要时提醒重启 Claude Code。
自主运行多迭代产品构建的Planner、Generator、Evaluator流水线，支持标准、严格和质量评估模式。
原始用途: PGE Orchestrator — autonomously runs Planner → Generator → Evaluator pipeline for multi-sprint product builds. Supports --evaluator flag for standard/strict/quality evaluation modes.

中文用途: 将工作流程depends_on解析为DAG，用Kahn算法计算并行执行层级，核验循环和步骤输出引用的传递性，作为解析结果到执行器的中间阶段。
原始用途: 파싱된 워크플로우의 depends_on을 DAG로 해석하고, Kahn 알고리즘으로 병렬 실행 레벨을 계산하며, 순환 참조와 step output 참조의 전이성을 검증하는 스킬. dependency-planner 에이전트가 사용. "DAG", "병렬 레벨", "실행 순서", "의존성", "순환 감지", "토폴로지 정렬", "step output 참조 검증" 언급 시 반드시 이 스킬로 처리. Parser 출력을 Executor 입력으로 변환하는 필수 중간 단계.

中文用途: 组织四位解析、依赖规划、执行和验证专家执行YAML流水线，处理重跑部分重跑及补充修改，保存中间文件以便审计和恢复，区别于单技能简单执行。
原始用途: YAML 워크플로우 파이프라인 실행을 조율하는 오케스트레이터 스킬. workflow-parser, dependency-planner, step-executor, workflow-verifier 4명의 전문 에이전트 팀을 구성하여 파싱 → 계획 → 실행 → 검증 라이프사이클을 수행한다. "워크플로우 실행", "pipeline", "파이프라인 조율", "run workflow", "워크플로우 파이프라인", "팀으로 워크플로우 실행", "workflow-builder run"의 고급 경로, "다시 실행", "재실행", "부분 재실행", "이전 결과 기반으로", "보완", "수정"이 언급되면 반드시 이 스킬로 처리. 단일 workflow-builder SKILL.md를 사용하는 단순 실행과 달리, 이 스킬은 전문가 팀 분산 실행을 제공하며 중간 산출물을 파일로 남겨 감사 추적과 부분 재실행을 가능하게 한다.

中文用途: 按计划的并行层级逐序执行命令、AI及批准步骤，捕获输出并遵循on_failure策略，作为工作流程执行核心。
原始用途: 계획된 병렬 레벨을 순서대로 실행하고, command/ai/approval step을 각 타입에 맞게 처리하며, step output을 캡처하고 on_failure 정책을 따르는 스킬. step-executor 에이전트가 사용. "step 실행", "명령 실행", "파이프라인 run", "병렬 실행", "on_failure", "output 캡처" 언급 시 반드시 이 스킬로 처리. 워크플로우 실행의 심장부이므로 run 요청에는 무조건 트리거.

中文用途: 查找解析YAML流程，按config.base、profiles及--set优先级合并变量并核验架构，完成执行前结构化预处理。
原始用途: YAML 워크플로우 파일을 찾고, 파싱하고, config.base/profiles/--set의 우선순위대로 변수를 병합하고, 스키마를 검증하는 스킬. workflow-parser 에이전트가 사용. 파이프라인 실행 전처리, "워크플로우 로드", "변수 병합", "스키마 검증", "YAML 파싱" 언급 시 반드시 이 스킬로 처리. 단순 파일 읽기가 아니라 워크플로우 구조를 이해해야 하는 모든 작업에 우선 트리거.

中文用途: 交叉核验已执行工作流程的结构一致性、步骤输出引用契约和确定性，生成QA报告，作为validate及结果可信度检查阶段。
原始用途: 실행된 워크플로우의 구조 정합성, step output 참조 계약, 결정성을 교차 비교로 검증하고 QA 리포트를 생성하는 스킬. workflow-verifier 에이전트가 사용. "검증", "verify", "QA", "determinism", "워크플로우 리포트", "품질 체크" 언급 시 반드시 이 스킬로 처리. 파이프라인 실행 후 결과 신뢰도 확인이 필요한 모든 상황에 우선 트리거. validate 서브커맨드의 핵심 단계.

中文用途: 生成并执行工作流程YAML，可通过/workflow-builder直接调用。
原始用途: 워크플로우 YAML을 생성하고 실행하는 스킬. "워크플로우", "workflow", "배포 플로우", "작업 흐름" 언급 시 사용. /workflow-builder로 직접 호출 가능.

中文用途: 在Figma建设卡片导航区块组件时，先查库组件、使用正确Auto Layout和语义节点命名；视觉属性绑定转figma-style-binding。
原始用途: Triggers when building any UI element in Figma — 'create a card', 'build a nav', 'add a section', 'make a component'. Enforces library-first component lookup, correct Auto Layout structure, and semantic node naming. For visual property binding (colors, text styles, spacing values), defer to figma-style-binding.

中文用途: 在Figma会话开始或首次接收文件URL时，验证MCP、读取CLAUDE.md、审计已连接库并加载全部样式变量的Token Map，作为设计前检查。
原始用途: Triggers on 'let's start', 'begin', 'preflight', 'start the session', or when a Figma file URL is first shared. Verifies MCP connection, reads CLAUDE.md, audits connected libraries, and loads a Token Map of all Styles and Variables — required before any design work.

中文用途: 在Figma创建文字、设色或修改间距内边距圆角等视觉属性时，将全部值绑定Styles或Variables，避免硬编码，并进行写入后QA。
原始用途: Triggers on any visual property change in Figma — creating text, setting colors, adjusting spacing/padding/gap/radius. Enforces that ALL values bind to Figma Styles or Variables, never hardcoded. Includes post-write QA verification.

中文用途: 解读用户提供的截图、图片、URL或设计描述，生成将视觉意图映射至设计令牌的结构化简报；用户确认后才开始设计。
原始用途: Triggers when user shares a screenshot, image, URL, or design description — or says 'analyze this', 'make a brief', 'interpret this reference'. Outputs a structured Design Brief mapping visual intent to design system tokens. Waits for 'confirmed' before designing.

中文用途: 列举所有Claude Code项目，并删除孤立项目。
原始用途: List every Claude Code project; delete the orphaned ones

中文用途: 列举和管理当前项目的会话。
原始用途: List and manage sessions in the current project

中文用途: 按Claude Code官方最佳实践，为已有仓库初始化整洁的.claude目录结构。
原始用途: Bootstrap a clean .claude/ folder structure for any existing repo following official Claude Code best practices

中文用途: 通过claude-md-management让CLAUDE.md与当前代码库保持同步。
原始用途: Keep CLAUDE.md files in sync with the current codebase using claude-md-management

中文用途: 在AI智能体代码工作中自动识别治理配置缺口。
原始用途: Automatically detect governance gaps when working on AI agent code

中文用途: 依据ClawMaven标准审计AI智能体治理配置。
原始用途: Audit an AI agent's governance configuration against ClawMaven standards

中文用途: 为AI智能体项目的治理状态评分。
原始用途: Score the governance posture of an AI agent project

中文用途: 为AI智能体部署生成带签名的信任清单。
原始用途: Generate a signed trust manifest for an AI agent deployment

中文用途: 配置Clawback渠道，保存连接令牌并检查状态，适用于提供令牌、配置请求或渠道状态检查。
原始用途: Set up the Clawback channel — save the connection token and check status. Use when the user pastes a connection token, asks to configure Clawback, or wants to check channel status.

中文用途: 根据自然语言创建Clawness规则，生成包含标签、触发条件和示例的YAML文件。
原始用途: Create a new Clawness rule from a natural language description. Describe what you want enforced and this will generate the YAML rule file with proper tags, triggers, and examples.

中文用途: 面向维护者逐域审查Clawness规则与当前官方文档的一致性，在每条规则记录applies_to/verified/sources版本标记，报告判断但不改写规则正文。
原始用途: Review one domain of the Clawness rule corpus for correctness against current official documentation, then record what was established as a version stamp (applies_to / verified / sources) on each rule individually. For maintainers and fork maintainers. Reports verdicts and writes stamps; never rewrites rule text.

中文用途: 为Clawness尚无规则库的技术栈研究官方约定、起草少量项目规则并lint验证；列出建议并在写入前停止等待批准，适用于覆盖为空提示或新技术栈。
原始用途: Author a starter set of Clawness rules for a project whose stack Clawness ships no corpus for (Ruby, PHP, Elixir, Haskell, C#, Swift, Dart, Scala, Clojure, ...). Researches the stack's current conventions from official documentation, drafts a small set of project rules into .clawness/rules/, lint-validates them, and stops for approval before writing anything. Run it when the SessionStart empty-coverage note fires, or whenever you want project rules for an uncovered stack.

中文用途: 精简过大的CLAUDE.md，测量逐轮常驻指令成本，删除代码已有说明，将路径专属和提示专属指导分移至相应规则目录，保留关键禁止撤销约束；属于有意的删除修改。
原始用途: Shrink an oversized CLAUDE.md. Measures what the project's always-loaded instructions cost per turn, then works through it section by section — cutting what the codebase already says, moving path-specific guidance to .claude/rules/ and prompt-specific conventions to .clawness/rules/, and leaving load-bearing "don't undo this" content where it is. Destructive and deliberate: run it when you have the session to spend.

中文用途: 创建运行项目专属检索评测，编写提示到预期规则案例，比较改动前后MRR@k和命中率，验证规则或基础提示精简后重要知识仍可检索。
原始用途: Build and run a project-specific retrieval eval so changes to your rules or base prompt are scored, not eyeballed. Mirrors tests/ground_truth.json + `clawness eval`: you write prompt→expected-rule cases, then measure MRR@k and hit-rate before and after an edit. Run it after trimming a base prompt into ranked retrieval (see openclaw-audit / claude-md), or whenever you change rules and want proof retrieval still surfaces what matters.

中文用途: 精简OpenClaw常驻系统文件，测量SOUL/AGENTS/IDENTITY/USER/MEMORY逐轮成本，移出可检索惯例和简短陷阱，保留关键人格身份；属于有意的删除修改。
原始用途: Trim an OpenClaw workspace's base system prompt. Measures what the always-injected workspace files (SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md, MEMORY.md) cost per turn, then works through them section by section — cutting what the tools or codebase already say, moving durable conventions to Clawness ranked retrieval (.clawness/rules/) and one-line traps to .clawness/memory.md, and leaving load-bearing persona and identity where they are. Destructive and deliberate: run it when you have the session to spend.

中文用途: 审计项目或指定模块性能，检查N+1、不必要重渲染、内存泄漏、包体积及慢算法。
原始用途: Run a performance audit on the project or a specific module. Checks for N+1 queries, unnecessary re-renders, memory leaks, bundle size issues, and slow algorithms.

中文用途: 依据项目实际安装使用的框架版本更新Clawness规则，研究验证后变化并准备版本正确的覆盖项，列清单后先等待批准再写入。
原始用途: Bring this project's Clawness rules up to date with the framework version it actually runs. Establishes what is installed and what the codebase uses, looks up what changed since the rules were verified, and writes version-corrected overrides into .clawness/rules/ — reporting the list and stopping for approval before it writes anything. Run it when the SessionStart version-gap note fires, or whenever a major upgrade lands.

中文用途: 对暂存变更或指定文件开展对抗式代码评审，委派code-critic发现缺陷、性能与遗漏边缘情况，用于提交或合并前。
原始用途: Run an adversarial code review on staged changes or a specific file. Spawns the code-critic agent to find bugs, performance issues, and missed edge cases. Use before merging PRs or committing.

中文用途: 对项目或模块开展有状态红蓝队安全审计，先用确定性clawness scan枚举攻击面，再累积发现台账，仅评估新增事项以收敛，适用于上线前或认证支付用户数据修改后。
原始用途: Run a stateful red team / blue team security audit on the current project or a specific module. First enumerates the attack surface deterministically with `clawness scan` (zero LLM tokens, identical every run) and accumulates verdicts in a findings ledger, so each pass adjudicates only what is NEW instead of re-scanning blind — turning a 5-10 run scan into 1-2 converging passes. Reach for this whenever the user asks for a security audit, a vulnerability scan, a code security review, or hardening — before deployment, after adding auth/ payment/user-data code, or on a schedule — even if they don't type the command.

中文用途: 展示当前Clawness加载规则、可用代理及钩子配置，了解项目向Claude提供了哪些规则。
原始用途: Show the current Clawness configuration: which rules are loaded, which agents are available, and how the hook is configured. Use to understand what rules Claude is seeing for this project.

中文用途: 依据已有测试模式与项目风格，为文件模块生成覆盖正常、边缘、错误及边界值的测试。
原始用途: Generate comprehensive tests for a file or module. Reads existing test patterns and matches the project's style. Covers happy paths, edge cases, error conditions, and boundary values.

中文用途: 扫描项目UI与公共API/CLI推断真实用户任务，按Diátaxis教程操作参考解释标准起草简洁终端用户或开发者文档；先提纲，批准后写入。
原始用途: Write user documentation for a project by scanning its codebase — its UI screens and its public API/CLI — inferring what someone can actually do with it, and drafting brief, task-oriented docs to the Diátaxis standard (tutorial / how-to / reference / explanation). Handles both non-technical end-user docs and developer docs. Use when asked to document the app, write user or API docs, generate a getting-started guide, or when the project's docs are missing or out of date. Scans and proposes an outline, then writes only after you approve it.

中文用途: 创建更新只读clawpage页面管理仪表板，默认3小时TTL和pagecode保护；浏览器JavaScript不得嵌入sk_令牌，即使有访问码保护。
原始用途: Create or refresh a read-only dashboard listing all of the user's clawpage pages. Trigger keywords — "管理页", "页面管理", "列出所有页面", "pages dashboard", "admin page", "read-only page list", "manage all my pages". Default policy is 3h TTL plus pagecode-protected. SECURITY-CRITICAL — never embed `sk_*` tokens in browser-shipped JS, even on a pagecode-protected page.

中文用途: 从内置模板创建公开URL上的单HTML clawpage，可把复杂回答、仪表板或单页应用独立分享；默认访问码保护且3小时TTL，明确选择后才公开永久，输出相关URL；编辑模板另用对应技能。
原始用途: Create a new clawpage page (single-file HTML hosted at a public URL) from a built-in template. TRIGGER PROACTIVELY when the user wants to convert a long/complex response into a distinct shareable URL, build a dashboard, or generate a single-page app for sharing. Default publish policy is private + 3h TTL (pagecode-required, ttlMs=10800000) unless the user explicitly opts public/permanent. Output must include `publicUrl`/`rootUrl`/`accessUrl`. Do NOT use for editing an existing page (use the `update-page` skill) or for template authoring (use `create-template`).

中文用途: 创建可复用clawpage模板的HTML/CSS/JS/meta文件，为未来页面提供风格基础；模板不带SDK脚本，需要动态能力时由页面另行加入。
原始用途: Create a new reusable clawpage template (`index.html` / `default.css` / `default.js` / `meta.md`) that page projects can scaffold from. Trigger when user says "new template", "create a clawpage template", "模板搭建", or wants to author a stylistic foundation for future pages. Templates ship without the SDK script — pages that need dynamic features add it via the `use-sdk` skill.

中文用途: 按明确pageId永久删除用户指定clawpage页面，无回收站且不可逆；不用于本地项目删除、临时下线或短链接KV文件等子资源。
原始用途: Permanently delete a clawpage page by its `pageId` via DELETE /api/pages/<pageId>. Trigger when the user explicitly asks to delete / remove / take down / destroy / 删除 / 下线 a specific page they own and a `pageId` (or a clearly identifiable single page) is in scope. Deletion is irreversible — there is no soft-delete or trash. NEVER fabricate a `pageId`. Do NOT use for removing a local page project only (just `rm -rf` the directory), do NOT use for unpublishing temporarily (use `update-page` to set a short TTL or `pagecode` instead), do NOT use for sub-resources like short links / KV records / blobs (use `manage-links` / `manage-data` / `manage-blobs` respectively).

中文用途: 初始化本机clawpage CLI，注册账户并保存API令牌至keys.local.json，已初始化时可幂等调用，强制换账户须明确选择--force。
原始用途: Initialize the clawpage cli on this machine — register a clawpage.ai account and save the API token to ~/.clawpage/keys.local.json. Trigger when the user says "init clawpage", "setup clawpage", "初始化", or starts a clawpage workflow without an existing token. Idempotent — safe to call when already initialized; exit code 2 means the user explicitly opted into --force to switch accounts.

中文用途: 上传图片或文件至Cloudflare R2并获得供Clawpage嵌入的公开URL，支持图片替换PDF分享和持久存储；所有上传均可由持有URL者查看。
原始用途: Upload images and files to Cloudflare R2 storage, get public URLs to embed in HTML pages. Use when the user wants to "upload a photo", "add an image to my page", "share a PDF", "replace the image", or needs persistent file storage for their Clawpage site. All uploads are public (anyone with the URL can view).

中文用途: 管理用户Clawpage服务端KV表的创建权限删除、记录CRUD、深合并、自动键追加及导入导出，用于评论点赞配置计数等持久状态；数据位于用户子域，所有者sk_令牌不得进入浏览器HTML。
原始用途: Manage a user's Clawpage KV data tables — create/permission/delete tables, CRUD records, deep-merge updates, auto-keyed appends, export/import. Use whenever a page needs server-side persisted data (comments, reactions, likes, visitor state, configs, content CMS, simple counters). The data lives under the user's own subdomain; the sk_ owner token is NEVER allowed to ship in browser HTML.

中文用途: 创建列举修改删除映射到Clawpage页面的短链接，目标仅限*.clawpage.ai，可分享公开或访问码预览及首页，外部URL不支持。
原始用途: Create, list, update, or delete short links that map https://clawpage.ai/s/<slug> → a *.clawpage.ai URL. Use when the user wants to share a cleaner/shorter URL for their own Clawpage page (public page, preview with pagecode, home page, etc.). Target URLs are restricted to *.clawpage.ai only — external URLs are rejected.

中文用途: 介绍clawpage preview本地预览体验，供创建更新页面在发布前预览时引用；仅参考文档，不直接调用。
原始用途: Reference doc explaining the local preview UX shipped by `clawpage preview`. Linked from create-page and update-page when the user opts to preview before publishing. Not directly invoked — for documentation only.

中文用途: 修改并重新发布已有Clawpage项目，保留pageId及公开根URL；需识别真实已有页面，无法识别时应新建而非编造ID。
原始用途: Update an existing clawpage page project and republish — preserves the same `pageId` / `publicUrl` / `rootUrl`. Trigger when the user mentions a known `pageId`, says "update existing page", "rework", "revise", "republish", or refers to an existing local page project (`~/.clawpage/pages/<name>` or `./.pages/<name>`, or "基于旧页面"). NEVER fabricate a `pageId` — if no existing page is identifiable, this is a `create-page` task instead.

中文用途: 更新已有Clawpage模板的结构样式交互与文档，保留发布兼容所需__SYSTEM__占位符和meta元数据。

中文用途: 按 Clean Architecture 定义、评审和执行架构边界，分离变化速率不同的策略与实现细节，保护内部业务层免受外部 UI/数据库依赖影响。
扫描完整代码库的 Clean Architecture 依赖规则违规，检查依赖是否只向内层，以及内层是否引用外层名称或实现。
分析 Clean Architecture 组件内聚与耦合，可限定路径或检查全部 src 模块，按六项组件原则评估部署单元和模块划分。
按 Clean Architecture 创建或审查 Controller，将 HTTP、CLI、消息或 gRPC 等框架输入转换为纯数据 Use Case 输入模型，放在 Interface Adapters 层。
分析项目的实体、用例、端口、适配器及依赖关系，生成 Clean Architecture 分层图和依赖图，帮助检查边界与依赖方向。
按 Clean Architecture 创建或审查领域 Entity，封装跨应用的企业核心业务规则，使其独立于 HTTP、SQL、ORM 和 UI。
创建或审查 Clean Architecture Gateway/Repository/Data Mapper，在 Interface Adapters 层实现 use case 输出端口，转换领域实体与数据库行或外部服务数据。
根据语言、框架和业务领域初始化或改造 Clean Architecture 项目，建立四层加 Main 的目录结构，并生成接口、占位实现和导出文件。
创建或更新 Clean Architecture 的 Main 组装入口，在最外层实例化具体组件并配置依赖注入，使业务层保持独立。
将现有项目逐层迁移到 Clean Architecture；从内部业务层向外推进，以测试保护既有行为，分步处理依赖与适配器。
按 Humble Object 模式创建或审查 Presenter，实现 use case 输出端口，将纯数据 Response Model 转为适合视图的展示数据，隔离难测试界面行为。
对整个代码库开展完整 Clean Architecture 审计，按主要架构概念检查项目结构、依赖与层次等，输出综合评分卡和按优先级排列的建议。
分析指定文件、目录或整个 src 中的 SOLID 原则违反情况，按职责、扩展、替换、接口和依赖问题提出重构建议，并可实施修复。
按 Clean Architecture 的测试边界为实体、用例、网关、控制器和展示器生成测试；业务单元测试隔离数据库与 HTTP，另设基础设施集成测试。
创建或审查 Clean Architecture Use Case，以独立于 UI、数据库和框架的应用业务规则协调 Entity，通过明确输入输出完成特定应用任务。
指导设计编写评审后端端点、支付及状态变更、数据库操作、服务调用、后台任务、风险变更发布和生产告警值班。
原始用途: Use when designing, writing, or reviewing backend code — HTTP endpoints, payment or state-changing flows, database reads and writes, calls to other services, background jobs, rolling out a risky change, or production alerting and on-call.

中文用途: 在初始 molt fetch 后，通过 CockroachDB replicator 持续复制 PostgreSQL、MySQL 或 Oracle 变更，配置 CDC、pglogical/mylogical/oraclelogminer 并管理切换流程。
原始用途: Guide for using the CockroachDB replicator to continuously replicate changes from PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle to CockroachDB after an initial molt fetch data load. Use when setting up CDC replication, configuring pglogical/mylogical/oraclelogminer, or managing the fetch → replicator cutover workflow.

中文用途: 使用 molt verify 核对迁移后源与目标库的结构和逐行一致性，调整并发/分片，处理结构不符并验证数据完整性。
原始用途: Guide for using molt verify to compare source and target databases for schema and row-level consistency after a migration. Use when running verify commands, tuning concurrency/sharding, handling schema mismatches, or validating data integrity post-migration.

中文用途: 下载官方二进制并启动本地 CockroachDB 开发集群，适用于无可用集群或新开发环境。
原始用途: Downloads and starts a local CockroachDB cluster for development using the official binary. Use when a developer needs a local CockroachDB instance, when no cluster is available, or when setting up a new development environment.

中文用途: 按 CockroachDB 部署档位管理 TLS 与加密密钥生命周期：自托管支持证书监测/轮换及 Kubernetes 证书；Advanced/BYOC 支持 KMS 中 CMEK 轮换，Standard/Basic 的 TLS 与加密全托管；CMEK 仅 Advanced 可用。
原始用途: Manages TLS certificate and encryption key lifecycle across all tiers. Self-Hosted covers certificate expiry monitoring, node/CA/client cert rotation, and Kubernetes cert management. Advanced/BYOC covers managed TLS (no action) and CMEK (Customer-Managed Encryption Key) rotation in your KMS. Standard and Basic have fully managed TLS and encryption with no customer action. CMEK is only available on Advanced. Use when monitoring cert health, performing rotation, managing CMEK, or responding to key compromise.

中文用途: 按 CockroachDB 档位管理容量与费用：自托管增节点或 decommission 永久移除，Advanced/BYOC 调整节点/机型，Standard 调整 vCPU，Basic 自动扩缩并管理支出上限。
原始用途: Manages CockroachDB cluster capacity across all tiers. Self-Hosted covers node decommissioning for permanent removal and adding nodes for expansion. Advanced/BYOC covers scaling node count and machine size via Cloud Console, API, or Terraform. Standard covers adjusting provisioned compute (vCPUs). Basic auto-scales — guidance covers spending limits and cost management. Use when scaling capacity up or down, permanently removing nodes, or managing costs.

中文用途: 按档位审查和调整 CockroachDB 设置：自托管可控全部设置/启动参数，Advanced/BYOC 多数 SQL 设置可改，Standard/Basic 主要使用会话变量与云控制台，基础设施由平台管理。
原始用途: Reviews, audits, and modifies CockroachDB cluster settings. Self-Hosted has full control over all settings and start flags. Advanced/BYOC can modify most SQL-level settings but infrastructure settings are managed by CRL. Standard has limited settings access — session variables are the primary tuning mechanism. Basic has minimal settings — use session variables and Cloud Console. Use when auditing configuration, tuning performance, or troubleshooting settings-related issues.

中文用途: 安排 CockroachDB 计划维护：自托管排空节点进行系统补丁/硬件/配置变更，Advanced/BYOC 配置维护窗口、补丁延迟与监控，Standard/Basic 由平台全托管。
原始用途: Manages planned cluster maintenance across all tiers. Self-Hosted covers node drain procedures for OS patching, hardware changes, and configuration updates. Advanced/BYOC covers maintenance window configuration, patch scheduling, deferral policies, and monitoring during CRL-managed maintenance. Standard and Basic maintenance is fully managed with no customer action. Use when planning maintenance, configuring maintenance windows, or preparing applications for maintenance events.

中文用途: 按档位配置 CockroachDB 生产集群：自托管 start/init、Kubernetes Operator/Helm 和硬件规格，Advanced/BYOC 用 Console/API/Terraform，Standard 选预置计算，Basic 设支出上限，并检查上线配置。
原始用途: Guides initial CockroachDB cluster provisioning and production deployment. Self-Hosted covers cockroach start/init, Kubernetes deployment (Operator, Helm), hardware sizing, and production configuration. Advanced/BYOC covers Cloud Console, API, and Terraform provisioning with production settings. Standard covers cluster creation and provisioned compute selection. Basic covers cluster creation and spending limits. Use when creating a new cluster, preparing for production go-live, or validating deployment configuration.

中文用途: 先确定部署档位，再开展 CockroachDB 全面健康检查：自托管用节点系统表与 CLI，Advanced/BYOC 用控制台/SQL 节点诊断，Standard 查计算与工作负载，Basic 查 Request Unit 与连通性，适用于日检、维护和事故后验证。
原始用途: Performs a comprehensive health check of a CockroachDB cluster. Gathers deployment context first, then provides tier-appropriate diagnostics. Self-Hosted uses SQL against node-level system tables and CLI. Advanced/BYOC use Cloud Console and SQL with node visibility. Standard monitors provisioned compute and workload via Cloud Console. Basic monitors Request Unit consumption and connectivity. Use for daily checks, pre-maintenance validation, post-incident verification, or production readiness assessment.

中文用途: 按档位指导 CockroachDB 版本升级：自托管滚动替换二进制并控制 finalization，Advanced/BYOC 在控制台发起大版本升级、配置补丁窗口和发布通道，Standard/Basic 自动升级。
原始用途: Guides CockroachDB version upgrades with tier-appropriate procedures. Self-Hosted covers manual rolling binary replacement with finalization control. Advanced/BYOC covers Console-initiated major upgrades, maintenance windows for patches, and release channel selection. Standard and Basic upgrades are fully automatic with no customer action required. Use when planning, executing, or monitoring a version upgrade.

中文用途: 编写、生成或优化 CockroachDB SQL 与表结构，说明类型映射和分布式实践，诊断缺少主键、顺序 ID 热点或错误类型等反模式。
原始用途: Use when writing, generating, or optimizing SQL for CockroachDB, designing CockroachDB schemas, or when the user asks about CockroachDB-specific SQL patterns, type mappings, and distributed database best practices. Also use when encountering CockroachDB anti-patterns like missing primary keys, sequential ID hotspots, or incorrect type usage.

中文用途: 按 CIS CockroachDB Benchmark v1.0.0 Level 1 审计自托管集群，支持快速自动扫描或完整程序，输出安装、系统加固、日志、用户、数据保护和设置的 PASS/FAIL/MANUAL 报告。
原始用途: Audits a self-hosted CockroachDB cluster against the CIS CockroachDB Benchmark v1.0.0 Level 1 controls. Supports two audit depths — quick automated scans and full CIS audit procedures. Produces a structured PASS/FAIL/MANUAL report covering installation, system hardening, logging, user access, data protection, and CockroachDB settings. Use when preparing for CIS compliance assessments, hardening self-hosted deployments, or validating security posture against industry benchmarks.

中文用途: 从网络、认证、授权、加密、审计日志和备份维度审查云端或自托管 CockroachDB 安全姿态，适用于上线准备、合规评审与配置缺口调查。
原始用途: Audits the security posture of a CockroachDB cluster (Cloud or self-hosted) across network, authentication, authorization, encryption, audit logging, and backup dimensions. Use when assessing cluster security readiness, preparing for compliance reviews, or investigating security configuration gaps.

中文用途: 配置 CockroachDB SQL 审计日志，记录认证、权限变更和敏感数据访问，建立按角色的审计策略并验证配置。
原始用途: Configures SQL audit logging on CockroachDB clusters to capture security-relevant events including authentication, privilege changes, and sensitive data access. Use when enabling audit logging for compliance, setting up role-based audit policies, or verifying audit configuration.

中文用途: 配置和加固 CockroachDB Cloud IP 允许列表，仅允许授权 CIDR，支持移除 0.0.0.0/0 等过宽规则及新集群网络限制。
原始用途: Configures and hardens IP allowlists for CockroachDB Cloud clusters to restrict network access to authorized CIDR ranges. Use when tightening network security, removing overly permissive allowlist entries like 0.0.0.0/0, or setting up allowlists for a new cluster.

中文用途: 将 CockroachDB Cloud 日志与指标导出到 AWS CloudWatch、GCP Cloud Logging 或 Datadog，支持审计/监控配置与日志投递排障。
原始用途: Configures log and metric export for CockroachDB Cloud clusters to external monitoring services including AWS CloudWatch, GCP Cloud Logging, and Datadog. Use when setting up log export for audit compliance, configuring metric export for monitoring, or troubleshooting log delivery issues.

中文用途: 配置 CockroachDB Cloud 的 AWS PrivateLink、GCP Private Service Connect、Azure Private Link、私有出口和 VPC peering，减少公网暴露并连接 Kafka 等外部服务。
原始用途: Configures private network connectivity for CockroachDB Cloud clusters including AWS PrivateLink, GCP Private Service Connect, Azure Private Link, egress private endpoints, and VPC peering. Use when setting up private endpoints to eliminate public internet exposure, configuring egress to external services like Kafka, or establishing VPC peering.

中文用途: 配置 CockroachDB 四层身份集成：Cloud Console SAML/OIDC、DB Console OIDC、SQL/Cluster JWT 或 LDAP/AD，以及 SCIM 2.0 自动用户配置，支持集中身份与生命周期管理。
原始用途: Configures SSO authentication and SCIM 2.0 provisioning for CockroachDB across four distinct layers — Cloud Console SSO (SAML/OIDC), DB Console SSO (OIDC), SQL/Cluster SSO (JWT or LDAP/AD), and SCIM 2.0 automated provisioning. Use when enabling centralized identity management, setting up SSO for compliance, or automating user lifecycle management.

中文用途: 在 CockroachDB Cloud Advanced 套餐及 Advanced Security Add-on 下启用 CMEK，通过云 KMS 控制静态数据加密密钥，支持合规、轮换和配置核验。
原始用途: Enables Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) on CockroachDB Cloud clusters with the Advanced plan and Advanced Security Add-on to give organizations control over data-at-rest encryption keys via their cloud provider's KMS. Use when enabling CMEK for compliance, rotating encryption keys, or verifying CMEK configuration.

中文用途: 配置 CockroachDB 密码最小长度、复杂度和哈希成本，强化认证或满足新集群/合规密码要求。
原始用途: Configures and enforces password policies on CockroachDB clusters including minimum length, complexity requirements, and hash cost settings. Use when strengthening authentication requirements, setting up password policies for a new cluster, or meeting compliance password standards.

中文用途: 审查并收紧 CockroachDB RBAC 权限，减少管理员授权、限制 PUBLIC 角色并落实最小权限，清理过度访问。
原始用途: Hardens CockroachDB user privileges by auditing and tightening role-based access control, reducing admin grants, restricting PUBLIC role permissions, and applying least-privilege principles. Use when reducing excessive privileges, cleaning up admin access, or implementing RBAC best practices.

中文用途: 管理 CockroachDB CA、客户端认证与 TLS 证书轮换，诊断 SSL/TLS 连接失败，并配置 CDC changefeed 所需 mTLS。
原始用途: Manages TLS certificates for CockroachDB clusters including CA certificate configuration, client certificate authentication, certificate rotation, and troubleshooting SSL/TLS connection errors. Use when setting up client certificate auth, resolving SSL connection failures, rotating certificates, or configuring mTLS for CDC changefeeds.

中文用途: 准备 CockroachDB Cloud 的 SOC 2、PCI DSS、ISO 27001、HIPAA 和 GDPR 合规资料，回应问卷、查找认证文件和评估配置准备度。
原始用途: Guides preparation of compliance documentation for CockroachDB Cloud deployments, covering SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR certifications. Use when responding to compliance questionnaires, preparing for audits, locating certification documents, or assessing cluster configuration for compliance readiness.

中文用途: 比较 CockroachDB 显式多语句事务和单语句 CTE 事务，按公平测试方法分析竞争、重试压力与性能，帮助判断是否将多步骤应用流程改为单 SQL。
原始用途: Guides benchmarking and comparing explicit multi-statement transactions versus single-statement CTE transactions in CockroachDB, with fair test methodology, contention analysis, and performance interpretation. Use when comparing transaction formulations, benchmarking CockroachDB workloads under contention, investigating retry pressure, or deciding whether to rewrite multi-step application flows into single SQL statements.

中文用途: 指导 CockroachDB 应用事务设计，涵盖生命周期、隐式/显式事务、指数退避重试、SQL 不变量、选择性悲观锁、集合操作、连接池、预编译语句、键集分页和 follower reads，区分业务与数据库逻辑。
原始用途: Guides application developers in designing correct and performant transaction patterns for CockroachDB, covering transaction lifetime, implicit vs explicit transactions, retry handling with exponential backoff, pushing invariants into SQL, selective pessimistic locking, set-based operations, connection pooling, prepared statements, keyset pagination, follower reads, and separating business logic from database logic. Use when building applications on CockroachDB, designing transaction workflows, handling retries, optimizing application-layer database interactions, or configuring connection pools.

中文用途: 选择并实现 CockroachDB 多地区应用模式，比较主备/双活、REGIONAL BY ROW、GLOBAL 表与带 lease preference 的手动地理分区，支持示例搭建和验证查询，优化跨区延迟。
原始用途: Guides developers in selecting and implementing multi-region patterns for CockroachDB applications, covering active-passive vs active-active architectures, REGIONAL BY ROW, GLOBAL tables, manual geo-partitioning with lease preferences, and live demo setup with validation queries. Use when designing multi-region database topologies, choosing between REGIONAL BY ROW and manual partitioning, building multi-region demos, or optimizing cross-region latency.

中文用途: 通过 SHOW RANGES 分析 CockroachDB 表和索引的 range 数量、大小、leaseholder 分布和副本健康，诊断热点、不均衡与碎片，并验证 zone 配置，无需 DB Console。
原始用途: Analyzes CockroachDB range distribution across tables and indexes using SHOW RANGES to identify range count, size patterns, leaseholder placement, and replication health. Use when investigating hotspots, uneven data distribution, range fragmentation, or validating zone configuration effects without DB Console access.

中文用途: 在大型表在线结构变更前，用 SHOW RANGES WITH DETAILS、KEYS、INDEXES 估算回填存储需求，适用于建索引、修改主键、物化视图、CTAS、刷新与 locality 变更，防止磁盘耗尽。
原始用途: Estimates storage requirements for CockroachDB online schema change backfills using SHOW RANGES WITH DETAILS, KEYS, INDEXES. Use before CREATE INDEX, ADD COLUMN with INDEX/UNIQUE, ALTER PRIMARY KEY, CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW, CREATE TABLE AS, REFRESH, or SET LOCALITY on tables with large per-index footprints, to avoid mid-backfill disk exhaustion.

中文用途: 通过 SHOW STATISTICS 审计 CockroachDB 优化器统计的时效、覆盖和质量，诊断慢查询或计划变化，并识别批量更新后需 CREATE STATISTICS 刷新的统计。
原始用途: Audits optimizer table statistics for staleness, missing coverage, and data quality issues using SHOW STATISTICS. Use when diagnosing poor query performance, unexpected plan changes, or after bulk data changes to identify stale statistics requiring refresh via CREATE STATISTICS.

中文用途: 通过 SHOW JOBS 和 SHOW AUTOMATIC JOBS 监控 CockroachDB 失败、暂停或长时间后台任务，涵盖结构变更、备份恢复、自动统计和 SQL 统计压缩，无需 DB Console。
原始用途: Monitors CockroachDB background job health by identifying failed, paused, and long-running jobs using SHOW JOBS and SHOW AUTOMATIC JOBS. Surfaces schema changes, backups/restores, automatic statistics collection, and SQL stats compaction jobs without DB Console access. Use when investigating schema change delays, failed backups, or automatic job issues.

中文用途: 使用 crdb_internal.statement_statistics 汇总 SQL 指纹，识别慢、资源密集或易出错的模式，分析历史趋势和反复慢查询，无需 DB Console。
原始用途: Ranks and analyzes statement fingerprints using aggregated SQL statistics from crdb_internal.statement_statistics to identify slow, resource-intensive, or error-prone query patterns. Use when investigating historical performance trends, identifying optimization opportunities, or diagnosing recurring slowness without DB Console access.

中文用途: 使用 crdb_internal.transaction_statistics 汇总事务指纹，分析高重试、竞争、提交延迟及问题语句组合，适用于历史趋势与重试风暴诊断。
原始用途: Analyzes transaction fingerprints using aggregated statistics from crdb_internal.transaction_statistics to identify high-retry transactions, contention patterns, and commit latency issues. Provides historical transaction-level analysis to understand which statement combinations are causing retries, contention, or performance degradation. Use when investigating transaction retry storms, analyzing commit latency trends, or understanding statement composition of problematic transactions without DB Console access.

中文用途: 通过纯 SQL 定位 CockroachDB 集群长查询、繁忙会话和活跃事务，诊断高 CPU、集群变慢及失控查询的来源应用，无需 DB Console。
原始用途: Diagnoses live CockroachDB cluster performance issues by identifying long-running queries, busy sessions, and active transactions using SQL-only interfaces. Use when users report cluster slowness, high CPU, or need to find runaway queries and their source applications without DB Console access.

中文用途: 作为需求预测第2至3步，计算量、ADI、CV²与趋势，划分SBC需求象限和层级细分，可比较机器聚类与规则，并按提前期建议预测单元和时域；阈值由用户确定。
原始用途: Use this skill for Steps 2–3 of demand-insight — the core series classification and per-segment spec. Computes the 4 axes (volume/ADI/CV²/trend), assigns SBC quadrants (Smooth/Erratic/Intermittent/Lumpy), builds hierarchical segments (~8–12), optionally runs ML clustering (k-means / shape / PCA) and compares it against the rule-based result, then proposes a per-segment forecast unit & horizon (lead-time aware). Thresholds are presented as starting points; the user decides. Use after EDA, or to re-classify on pattern change / new stores.

中文用途: 作为需求预测第1步开展理解、预处理与质量检查，分析缺失、残差异常事件标记、分解、相关、平稳性与变点，输出EDA报告并更新状态，不直接删除异常。
原始用途: Use this skill for Step 1 of demand-insight — data understanding, preprocessing, and quality checks. Runs missing-value pattern analysis (time-aware interpolation), outlier detection (3σ residual → is_event flag, not deletion), STL/MSTL decomposition, ACF/PACF, ADF stationarity, and change-point detection. Outputs an EDA report and merges a summary into state.json for downstream classification. Use after the H1–H8 hearing or when data is refreshed.

中文用途: 作为需求预测评估与报告阶段，计算准确度、缺货过量、非对称成本、概率质量及偏差，更新假设与下一步，可做层级协调并生成以功能为主的Excel报告。
原始用途: Use this skill for Steps 6 & 8 of demand-insight — error analysis, business-KPI translation, and the Excel report. Computes accuracy metrics (MAE/RMSE/MAPE/MASE/WMAPE), fulfillment metrics (stockout/overstock), asymmetric business cost, probabilistic quality (Pinball/CRPS, interval coverage), detects systematic bias (by weekday/period/segment), updates hypotheses, recommends next_action (decision.json), optionally reconciles hierarchies (MinTrace), and emits a function-first Excel (.xlsx) report. Use after each modeling iteration, or to produce the final report.

中文用途: 为需求预测构建日历、周期、节假日、滞后、滚动与外生特征，严格防泄漏，目标衍生特征shift(1)，遵守预测时域可得性，输出特征计划与前滚安全数据。
原始用途: Use this skill for Step 4 of demand-insight — building forecast features with strict data-leakage prevention. Generates calendar, cyclical (sin/cos), holiday (incl. pre/post), lag, rolling, and exogenous features, enforcing shift(1) on all target-derived features and the horizon-availability constraint (lags < h are future information for Direct forecasting). Outputs feature_plan.json and a Walk-Forward-safe features table. Use after classification, or when error analysis calls for new explanatory power.

中文用途: 按需求细分建立朴素等基线及LightGBM、Croston、SBA或TSB模型，执行带提前期间隔的前滚验证和自助预测区间，解释特征与SHAP，仅采用优于基线的高级模型。
原始用途: Use this skill for Steps 5 & 7 of demand-insight — build, backtest, and interpret per-segment models. First builds Naive/Seasonal-Naive/MA/SES baselines via StatsForecast, then applies the segment-appropriate advanced model (LightGBM/Croston/SBA/TSB) with skforecast, runs Walk-Forward Validation with bootstrapped prediction intervals (lead-time gap), and extracts feature importance / SHAP. Adopts an advanced model only if it beats baseline. Use after feature engineering, after a G1 model-family switch, or to measure baselines alone.

中文用途: 在需求预测模型通过验收后生成生产预处理、无泄漏特征、训练、带区间批量预测、泄漏与回测可复现测试及部署配置，参数化模板到项目。
原始用途: Use this skill once a model has been accepted (acceptance criteria met / next_action=accept) to generate a production implementation — preprocessing, feature building (leakage-safe), training, batch prediction with intervals, a pytest suite (leakage + backtest reproducibility), and deployment config. Copies and parameterizes the templates into the user's project src/ and tests/. Use when the user says "productionize", "generate production code", "make it deployable", or after the loop accepts a model.

中文用途: 启动或协调需求预测八步循环，访谈业务、识别数据模式、初始化输入状态，再组织EDA、分类、细分、特征、建模、误差与报告，依据验收决定下一步。
原始用途: Use this skill to start or coordinate a use-case-driven demand-forecasting & data-analysis project — running the 8-step iterative loop (hearing → EDA → classification → segment spec → features → modeling → error analysis → report). Use when the user says "start demand forecasting", "improve forecast accuracy", "run the whole loop", or invokes /demand-insight.

原始用途: Audits a repository's durable artifacts — design tokens and config files, CLAUDE.md and style docs, hardcoded component defaults, git/PR/session history, and prior design-review or design-planning outputs from other tools (critic-layer notes, design briefs, style critiques, layout reviews) — to surface design decisions that quietly became permanent canon, including ones nobody consciously chose. Use this whenever the user wants to update, refresh, realign, or rewrite their design docs or project instructions after a design-direction shift; whenever they say things like "our docs are stale," "CLAUDE.md still says the old style," "make the docs match what we''re doing now," "formalize the new direction," or "resolve the conflicts from the canon report"; and whenever a canon-check audit just finished and the user accepts the offer to update. 中文用途: 搜索 Glean 企业知识，返回带新鲜度和权威性提示的已核查结果；涉及多工具综合的广泛问题使用 using-glean。

For broader enterprise queries needing synthesis across multiple tools, prefer the using-glean skill instead.

中文用途: 跨内部仓库寻找相似实现和代码模式先例，用于确认已有方案或获取参考实现。

中文用途: 跨组织仓库检索分析内部源码，查找系统实现、仓库、作者、相似模式和 API 示例；当前本地代码优先本地检索，设计文档和无代码背景人员查询使用其他 Glean 参考。

中文用途: 通过 Glean 汇总用户自己的工作活动、成果、优先事项、阻塞与近期背景，用于周总结、状态更新、1:1 和晨报；不用于他人活动或非用户主体项目状态。

Trigger phrases include what have I been working on, what did I do last week, what should I focus on, summarize my week, help me with my status update, what's blocking me, morning briefing, what happened while I was out. 中文用途: 开展结构化企业 KYB 或尽职调查，确认实体并汇总官方注册、董事、股东、集团结构和财务信息。

Use when the user asks to run due diligence, a KYB check, a compliance review, or to "check out" / "vet" a company.

中文用途: 为单个企业生成简短档案，包含身份、规模、财务要点和数字足迹，适用于名称、官网或 LinkedIn URL 查询，不制作完整 KYB 档案。
